normal-path spline evaluation and transformed movement position

evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected method identities, complete bounded native body bytes, selected field offsets and direct call targets are verified against one installed native build.
evidenceBoundary.direct: The unpatched LevelData spline-table getter inserts rows keyed by splineId. The unpatched MovePipelineSpline.OnEnter reads the selected row by m_splinePtr.id, passes knots and closed to Spline construction, forms m_splineTransform with position, rotation converted by an unnamed helper and unit scale, then projects MovementComponent.logicPos through its inverse. ProcessVelocity calls SplineUtility.Evaluate and applies m_splineTransform.MultiplyPoint to the evaluated position.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: These paths are behind iFix IsPatched checks. The selected installed patch state and whether a concrete entity entered spline movement are unobserved; direct describes reviewed normal-branch code, not executed movement.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: The unnamed rotation conversion helper, patch branches, non-movement spline consumers, scene/file selection, and map projection remain open. Do not render knots as world coordinates without the row transform.
